text:
maria: Heads-up — customer-reported perf regression on A100 images after CUDA 12.3 driver update. Seeing token latency spikes ~2-3x in some workloads. INC-4321 opened.
ali: Ack. Which marketplace images are affected? azure/rdw-inference:v2?
maria: Yes, specifically azure-marketplace: redwood-inference-v2 and a handful of partner AMIs. Repro steps attached in the ticket.
kevin: Quick check: driver version on the images is 535.54.03 + CUDA 12.3. We've seen similar behavior with that driver on older kernel combos.
samira: Can confirm on a small repro — perf drops at sequence lengths >1024, KV cache misses spike. Logs show warnings about cuBLAS heuristic fallbacks.
ali: OK — immediate plan: move to a pinned driver version that we know is stable (535.45.01?) for marketplace images and publish a canary doc. @kevin can you validate which exact driver build to pin?
kevin: I can validate. I'll run head-to-head perf on 535.45.01 and 535.54.03 by EOD. If 535.45 wins, we'll prepare an image rebuild.
maria: Marketplace team needs the timeline for update + joint customer comms. We should avoid breaking Dedicated customers — are Dedicated hosts isolated from this change?
kevin: Dedicated pools use a different AMI pipeline; they won't auto-update. We'll coordinate a separate patch window.
tk: Suggested rollback plan: 1) Pin marketplace images to driver 535.45.01, 2) Canary to 5% of traffic for 2 hours with detailed traces, 3) If green, promote to 100% and post-mortem. I can own the canary rollout. :thumbsup:
ali: Sounds good. Marketplace listing needs a short note: "Temporary driver pin for stability: 535.45.01". I'll draft. Who's writing the customer-facing message?
maria: I can draft the technical note + FAQ for SIs. Will share in the #partners-channel for review.
kevin: Ran the perf jobs — 535.45.01 shows 18% lower p95 latency on the test model vs 535.54.03. I'll attach logs to INC-4321.
deploy-bot: deploy request created: PR #8274 to pin driver in marketplace image buildpack. CI: pending.
ali: Great. timeline: if CI passes, can we cut the canary image tomorrow 09:00 PT and start 5% canary 10:00 PT?
tk: Yes, I'll schedule the canary and set rollback triggers (p95 + error rate).
samira: Also recommend we add a quick kernel/driver compatibility test in the marketplace CI to catch this earlier. Small e2e runner that hits seq len 2048.
kevin: Agreed — I'll add the test to the image pipeline after the patch is merged.
maria: For partner coordination: partner SI teams need a heads-up and an ask not to auto-upgrade their fleet for 24h. ali — can you ping top-5 SIs with the note once draft is ready?
ali: On it. I'll include the expected ETA and rollback instructions.
maria: Thanks. After canary completes I'll open a short postmortem draft and tag folks.
tk: If canary fails, immediate action: revert to previous image, pause marketplace listing updates, and escalate to infra oncall.
kevin: CI passed for PR #8274. Image build kicked off.
deploy-bot: marketplace image build succeeded: img-2026-03-22-09. Canary group updated to use img-2026-03-22-09 at 10:05 PT.
maria: Canary metrics look good at 1h — p95 back to baseline, no error uptick. Continue 2hrs then promote.
ali: I'll hold customer comms draft for final metrics. Thanks team! :rocket:
